title: Normalized derived quotient scalar extension
statement: Let J,O,ell and B_n be as in the strict coefficient construction [lem-pur-coefficient-evaluation-strict-extension], and choose arbitrary unbounded derived categories at every level [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For n<=m the actual sheafified quotient scalar extension T_mn, with its ordinary adjunction normalized on 1 tensor x, has a universal left derived functor computed on every K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex]. It is left adjoint to exact derived quotient restriction. For every complex P, every complex K at the target level, and every map f:T_mn P to K, its derived transpose after the universal comparison equals the localization of its specified ordinary complex transpose followed by the inverse restriction comparison.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21: the functors e_n! and (Le_n!, e_n^-1), with indices shifted from n >= 0 to n >= 1. The natural sigma maps are the truncation inclusions in its explicit formula; the Hom identity specifies their adjunction mates.

proof.text: Restricting scalars is exact. The independent-coefficient derived-change theorem supplies a tensor functor with the prescribed object/map formulas, hence equal to the fixed tensor functor; transport its K-flat quasi-isomorphism preservation.

Every complex admits a K-flat resolution. Apply the normalized resolving-class adjunction theorem with the fixed ordinary scalar adjunction and assemble the derived scalar model, retaining its counit and all-representative transpose.
